exposure: Injury mechanism (accidental trauma, non-accidental trauma, Cesarean-section, vaginal delivery)
outcome: Misdiagnosis rates of transphyseal humeral separations (TPHS)
Diagnostic accuracy of ED/consulting physicians and radiologists
cohort: 79 patients up to 4 years of age with surgically treated TPHS from five academic pediatric institutions over a 25-year period
finding: Injury mechanism, but not age, was significantly correlated with misdiagnosis rates of TPHS, highlighting the need for increased awareness and consideration of advanced imaging or orthopedic consultation for accurate diagnosis.
